title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — prototype compliance matrix

effective_updates.2026-02-13: E-commerce entities selling imported products must provide searchable and sortable country-of-origin filtering from 1 July 2026.
effective_updates.2026-04-27: The substituted Rule 6(10A) country-of-origin filter requirement is stated to come into force from 1 July 2027.
effective_updates.2026-05-29: Third Amendment Rules, 2026 effective on publication; permits mandatory declarations at bonded warehouses of AEO Tier-2/Tier-3 operators, provided retail packages have all mandatory declarations before leaving those warehouses; adds director-name detail and annual online detail update requirements to Rule 27.
